purpose: Record which official public products can be acquired for a future candidate-neutral timing estimator, while keeping the existing T-054 forward method and T-059 inverse contract unchanged.

source_products.role: public gravitational-wave strain and event metadata
source_products.product_description: The event release exposes public strain data and links to the GW170817 data products.
The LIGO public page lists GW170817 posterior sample files and the associated data-release material.
The GBM product documentation identifies burst TTE files and detector response matrices; the event-specific bytes and calibration version are not locally frozen here.

source_boundary.confirmed_scope: Official pages establish that raw or posterior products are publicly discoverable.
source_boundary.not_confirmed: No source-owned joint detector-frame timing likelihood or component covariance has been admitted into the local T-059 packet.
source_boundary.distinction: A raw strain, posterior sample, TTE, or detector response file is an input product, not the joint timing likelihood required for candidate scoring.

likelihood: source-owned or explicitly versioned candidate-neutral timing estimator
joint likelihood or covariance with component correlations
intrinsic-emission nuisance law or declared set-valued alternative

adversarial_review.check: Public raw strain or TTE availability does not create a source-owned timing likelihood or covariance.
Parameter-estimation samples are not inserted as an independent timing datum beside the source timing summary.
Any timing estimator derived from raw products must receive a new version, calibration contract, nuisance law and scorer before use.
HOLD-LC-001 remains retrospective and receives no prospective credit; no candidate is scored.
This boundary adds only an input-availability pointer; T-054, T-059, R-192 slot order and existing estimands are unchanged.

assumptions: The listed official URLs remain the discovery locators for the named products on the recorded date.
Product availability does not imply that a reproducible likelihood, covariance or calibration file is supplied.
The existing HOLD-LC-001 source packet and unweighted set-valued envelope remain the controlling local estimand versions.
A future raw-data estimator, if pursued, will be candidate-neutral and separately versioned before any map evaluation.
missing_assumptions: Locally downloaded and hash-pinned event-specific strain, posterior and TTE bytes.
A source-owned or explicitly reproducible joint timing likelihood and component covariance.
Detector calibration, background, selection and geocentric time-conversion contract.
A calibrated intrinsic-emission nuisance law or an explicitly retained set-valued rule.
A complete candidate-neutral estimator and F_reg/F_lim/F_eff/F_obs map.
An immutable scorer, acceptance threshold and prospective target.
evidence_level: T0 public-product discovery and input-contract boundary; no model test
next_action: If this path is pursued, download and hash-pin the exact event products, write a new candidate-neutral estimator package with fixed calibration and nuisance rules, and run only its source/lineage self-tests. Until then retain HOLD-LC-001 as feasibility-only and keep candidate scoring stopped.
non_claims: No candidate is admitted, selected, ranked, fitted or prospectively validated.
Raw strain, posterior samples and TTE files do not by themselves establish a timing likelihood or covariance.

No microscopic dynamics, physical vacuum, Reading-H branch, causal cone, Pre-A, Sector-A, C6, A13, QFT, Yang-Mills, gravity, continuum, cosmic-origin, theory-of-everything or mass-gap statement is established.
This boundary does not alter any existing forward or inverse research method.
